The compounds are the payoff: 交通工具 means of transport · 工具书 reference work · 生产工具 · 工具栏 toolbar. Figurative: 把人当工具 · 工具人.
Online 'follow': 关注了这个博主 · 取消关注 unfollow. Also 'pay close attention to' an issue: 关注环保/民生. Noun-ish: 引起/受到关注 · 关注度.
Frame 跟/和 A 一样 (+adj): 跟他一样高 · 和以前不一样. Alone: 都一样. Intensified as 一模一样 yìmúyíyàng exactly alike — 模 is mú there.
想办法 come up with one · 有/没办法 · 没办法了 nothing to be done · 想尽办法 · 用这个办法. 方法 is the systematic method (学习方法); 办法 solves the problem at hand.
Documents and news only: 此次活动/会议/事故/访问. Speech uses 这次. Same 此 family: 此外 besides · 此后 · 因此 · 特此.
Making something crafted or produced: 手工制作 · 制作视频/节目/网页 · 制作人 producer. 制造 is industrial output and also 制造麻烦/噪音; 做 is the everyday word.
Separable: 得了两分 · 一分没得. As a noun 'points scored': 得分最高 · 平均得分. 比分 is the scoreline of a match; 分数 is a grade.
Separable: 回了一封信 · 回封信. The addressee takes 给: 给我回信. As a noun 一封回信. For email and chat today it's 回复/回消息.
Adverbial before a verb: 努力学习/工作. Predicate: 他很努力. With a verb phrase: 努力做到最好. Noun in 做出努力 · 白费努力. Degree words fit: 非常努力.
Mostly a noun: 生活水平/习惯/压力/条件 · 日常生活. As a verb it takes no object, just a setting: 生活在农村 · 生活得很幸福. 住 is residing; 活 is being alive.
Takes people and abstractions alike: 尊重父母 · 尊重别人的选择/事实/意见. 互相尊重 · 受到/得到尊重 · 不尊重. 尊敬 is looking up to elders and superiors.
为…干杯 'here's to…': 为友谊干杯 · 为你的成功干杯. 干了！ alone = bottoms up; 我干了，你随意 lets the other off lightly. 敬你一杯 is the polite offer.
21世纪 · 上世纪/本世纪 · 世纪初/中期/末 · 半个世纪 · 跨世纪. Decades need 年代: 上世纪80年代 = the 1980s.
Beyond martial arts: 下功夫 put the work in · 花/费功夫. For the 'time to spare' sense it is usually written 工夫: 有工夫吗 got a minute · 一会儿工夫.
Size takes 多/少, not 大/小: 人口不多 · 人口众多. 人口增长/老龄化/密度 · 人口普查 census. A family's headcount uses 口 alone: 我家有五口人.
Care for a person: 照顾孩子/病人/老人 · 照顾好自己. Second sense, making allowances: 照顾一下他的情绪/困难 · 请多照顾 · 照顾生意 give someone your custom.
Transitive — someone changes something: 改变看法/主意/命运/习惯 · 改变不了. Change that just happens is 变/变化 (上海变化很快). Noun: 发生了改变.
The pre-class half of the pair 预习/复习: 预习课文/生词 · 提前预习. Only for lessons you're about to be taught; 准备 covers everything else.
遵守/违反法律 · 法律责任/规定/效力 · 法律援助. A single statute is 法 (宪法/劳动法); 法规 covers regulations. 合法/非法 are the adjectives.
商业模式 business model · 思维/发展/管理模式 · 飞行模式 airplane mode · 模式化. For someone's lifestyle, 生活方式 is the more usual pairing.
在…过程中 is the main frame: 在学习/谈判过程中 during. Also 整个过程 · 制作/生产过程 · 过程很复杂. 程序 is a set procedure; 步骤 are the individual steps.
Life as biological existence: 珍惜/挽救生命 · 生命危险 · 生命力 vitality · 一条生命. 生活 is daily living; 人生 is the course of a life.
Two jobs: a text message (发/收/回信息) and information (个人信息 · 信息量 · 信息技术). 消息 is news you hear about something: 好消息 · 听到消息.
做报告 = give a talk; 写/交/提交报告 = the document (份 is the unit). As a verb, reporting upward: 向领导报告 · 报告老师！ in class. 报告会 a lecture event.
提/发表/征求意见 for suggestions. But 对某人有意见 means holding a grievance against them, not merely having a view. 意见不一致 · 保留意见 · 意见箱.
有…的历史 states age: 有两千年的历史 · 历史悠久. 历史上 'in history' opens a clause. 学历史 the subject · 历史性时刻 historic moment · 历史遗留问题.
Official release: 发布消息/公告/命令/报告 · 新品发布会 launch event. 发表 is for articles and speeches; 公布 makes results public; 发 is everyday posting.
Goes after the surname as address: 邓主任 · 王主任. 班主任 is a homeroom teacher, 主任医师 a senior consultant doctor. 副主任 deputy.
跟/与…有关 be connected to: 这跟你有关吗. Before a noun it means 'the relevant': 有关部门/单位/人员 · 有关…的书. Opposite 无关: 与我无关.
Adverb before the verb: 四处寻找/张望/走动/打听. 到处 is the everyday equivalent and also follows 是 (到处都是人), a slot 四处 rarely fills.
Preposition 'by way of', before the means: 通过协商/努力/朋友介绍. Verb 'pass': 通过考试/审查 · 获得通过. 经过 is passing through a place or process.
Noun 'showing, conduct': 表现很好 · 在工作中的表现. Verb with 出: 表现出兴趣/勇气/天赋. Reflexive 表现自己 leans toward showing off. 表演 is performing on stage.
A standalone college or conservatory (音乐/美术/电影学院) or a faculty inside a 大学 (商学院/工学院). Below it is the 系 department; 院长 is the dean.
Sets ordinary days against a special one: 平时不学习，考试才着急. Before the verb or fronted: 你平时喜欢做什么. 平常 overlaps and also works as an adjective 'ordinary'.
Escalates the second clause, often paired with 不但/不仅: 不但便宜，而且好用. Even alone it needs a preceding statement. 并且 is flatter and more written.
着 is zháo here. 别着急 · 为孩子着急 (为 marks what worries you) · 着急回家 anxious to get home. Colloquial split: 着什么急！ 'what's the rush'.
Straight before the noun, no measure word: 许多汽车/许多人; 的 optional. Slightly written — 很多 is the spoken default and the one that works as a predicate (人很多).
内容很难/丰富/充实 · 主要内容 · 内容提要 · 以下内容. Paired against 形式 form. Also 'content' in the online sense: 内容创作者 · 优质内容.
Beyond 'exist': 存在问题/困难/差别 is the standard way to say 'there are problems' in reports. Also 存在于…之中 · 不存在 'no such thing' · 客观存在.
Numeric 'and above': 三年以上的经验 · 60分以上 (normally counted as including the number). Textual 'the above': 以上就是我的看法 · 综上所述. Mirrors 以下.
在…之前 or bare X之前: 睡觉之前 · 三天之前. Standing alone it means 'earlier than now': 之前我说过. 以前 is the everyday twin and alone means 'back in the day'.
张 is the classifier: 一张图片 · 发图片 · 配图 · 图片来源. A photograph specifically is 照片; a chart or diagram is 图/图表.
Straight before the noun, no measure word: 任何人/地方/问题/时候. Very at home under negation: 没有任何理由 · 不接受任何借口.
Institutional register: 儿童节 · 儿童医院/文学/乐园 · 儿童票. In conversation you'd say 孩子/小孩儿. 少年 is the older band, 青少年 the teens.
Links two predicates about one subject, often after 不但/不仅: 宽敞并且明亮 · 他答应了并且照做了. Flatter and more written than 而且, which adds 'what's more'.
Adjective, takes no object: 这件衣服很合适 · 合适的人选 · 不太合适. When you need an object use the verb 适合: 这工作适合你. 合身 is clothing fit specifically.
Three uses: attitude nouns — 表示感谢/歉意/关心; reporting a statement — 他表示，会考虑; signifying — 红灯表示停止. 表达 is putting content into words.
Also an adjective meaning 'sound, rational': 这个办法不科学 · 科学地安排时间. Compounds: 科学家 · 科学技术/科技 · 自然/社会科学 · 科学院.
Adverbially it means 'briefly': 简单说一下 · 简单介绍. 不简单 is praise — 'quite something'. Also 结构简单 · 简单的方法 · 头脑简单 simple-minded.
Closes the if-clause, often echoing 如果/要是 at the front, with 就 in the result: 有时间的话，就来吧. Fixed: 不然的话 · 要不然的话 otherwise. Purely optional — the 如果 clause works without it.
X以前: 三天以前 · 下班以前 · 走以前给我打个电话. Alone it means 'in the past': 我以前住在上海. 之前 is the more written twin and points to a specific earlier moment.
Takes the thing or the person directly: 反对这个方案 · 父母反对我们结婚. Degrees: 强烈/坚决反对. Opposite 赞成/支持. Also 表示反对 · 反对意见 · 反对票.
Intransitive and mostly a noun: 变化很大/很快 · 发生了变化 · 气候变化. Nothing follows it as an object — to change something is 改变.
Verb: 代表公司/全体同学发言 · 这不代表我同意. Noun 'delegate': 人大代表 · 派代表. Also 代表作 signature work · 代表性 representative · 代表队.
Pivot: 要求+person+verb phrase (as on the card) · 要求他道歉. Noun: 提出要求 · 符合/达到要求 · 对质量的要求 · 高要求. 要 reads yāo in this word.
调 reads diào here (tiáo in 调整). 对…进行调查 is the formal frame · 调查结果/报告 · 问卷/民意调查 poll · 调查案件 · 社会调查.
Chiefly a romantic date: 去约会 · 有个约会 · 约会对象. A business appointment is 预约 or 约时间. The bare verb 约 does the asking: 约他吃饭.
Concessive, answered by 也/都 in the second clause: 哪怕下雨我也要去 · 哪怕只有一次. 即使 is the written twin, 就算 the colloquial one.
Adverb before the verb: 她总是迟到. 老是 is the grumbling colloquial version. Watch the scope: 总是不来 'never comes' vs 不总是来 'doesn't always come'.
Its main life is as a result complement: 听/看/说/写清楚 · 弄清楚 get it straight · 没听清楚. 我不清楚 = 'I'm not sure'. Predicate: 讲得很清楚.
Written 更, and it prefers a two-syllable word after it: 更加重要/明显/努力. Plain 更 handles 更好/更大. Both imply a basis of comparison.
Marks a past experience now over, usually with 过 or 了: 曾经去过/住过. The negative is 不曾/未曾 or plain 没(有). 已经 is 'already' and points at the present.
申请/获得/拿到奖学金 · 全额奖学金 full ride · 国家奖学金. 助学金 is need-based aid; 学费 is tuition; 奖金 is a work bonus.
Form-field vocabulary: 性别：男/女 · 性别歧视/平等/差异 · 性别比例. For an animal you'd more likely just say 公的/母的.
Textbook cover-term for words and set phrases: 词语搭配 collocation · 常用词语. 单词 is an individual word (esp. in language study), 词汇 the vocabulary as a body, 生词 new words.
The fuller, more written 能; it prefers a two-syllable verb: 能够理解/完成/实现/早日康复. Questions and short answers take plain 能 (能吗？能), and the negative is 不能.
The object is the problem, not the person: 解决问题/矛盾/困难/纠纷. Potential form 解决不了/得了. Passive: 问题得到了解决. 解答 is answering a question.
A变成B, the result following directly: 水变成冰 · 把它变成机会. 成为 is the written 'become' for roles and statuses (成为医生), where 变成 implies transformation.
条 is the classifier: 一条新闻. 看/听新闻 · 上新闻 make the news · 新闻发布会 · 新闻联播. 消息 is a single piece of information you hear.
Verb and noun both: 回忆起往事 · 美好的回忆 · 留下回忆 · 回忆录 memoir. 想起 is the sudden 'it came back to me'; 记得 is simply still holding it.
Adverb before the predicate: 几乎一样 · 几乎所有人 · 几乎每天. With a negative it means 'hardly': 几乎不说话 · 几乎没睡. 差不多 is the spoken 'about, nearly'.
Written: adverb before the verb (最终决定不买) or attributive (最终目标/结果/胜利). 最后 is the neutral 'last in sequence'; 终于 adds relief at a long wait.
People only: 年轻人 · 年轻时 · 他比我年轻两岁 · 年轻有为. A young animal or plant takes 小/幼; a young company is 新成立的.
Written 找, for searches with some weight: 寻找答案/机会/线索/参考书/失踪者. Everyday looking is 找 (找钥匙); the result 'found it' is normally 找到.
Named regions and zones: 贫困/沿海/农村地区 · 亚太地区 · 港澳台地区, a deliberately careful cover term. 地方 is any place; 区 is an urban district.
分析/收集/处理数据 · 数据显示… the frame for citing figures · 数据库 database · 大数据 · 流量数据. 资料 is source material; 数字 are the numerals.
A body of thought, not a single idea — that's 想法/主意. 毛泽东思想 · 思想工作 political persuasion · 思想上 · 思想家 · 解放思想.
The scoreline: 比分是2比1 (X比Y) · 比分领先/落后 · 追平比分 level it · 改写比分. 得分 is points scored; 分数 is a grade on a test.
Separable-ish: 获了大奖 · 获过两次奖. Attributive: 获奖作品/影片/名单/感言. 得奖 is the everyday twin; to name the prize use 获得…奖: 获得诺贝尔奖.
Intransitive, the aircraft is the subject: 飞机九点起飞 · 准时/延误起飞 · 起飞时间. Landing is 降落/着陆. Figurative: 经济起飞.
A domain word, used attributively: 体育课/老师/馆/用品/新闻/比赛. Exercising is 运动 (做运动); an individual sport is a 项目 (体育项目).
Systemic, institutional change: 进行/推行改革 · 改革开放 the Reform and Opening policy · 经济体制/教育改革 · 改革者. Personal change is 改变.
Adjective: 你真幸运 · 幸运的是… 'fortunately' opening a clause · 幸运儿 · 幸运数字. The noun 'luck' is 运气: 运气好 · 碰运气.
Works both ways: 经济发展很快 (intransitive) and 发展经济/旅游业 (transitive). 发展中国家 developing country · 发展成… grow into · 可持续发展.
Where physical states land: 肚子疼/饿/胀 · 肚子饿了 is the normal 'I'm hungry'. The organ itself is 胃 (胃疼). 大肚子 = pregnant, or a beer belly.
发 reads fà here. Separable: 理了个发 · 理过发. 去理发 · 理发店/理发师. For a woman's salon visit you'd more often hear 剪头发/做头发.
Collective and formal — a category of staff: 工作/服务/医务/技术/安保人员 · 全体人员 · 人员不足. A single employee is 员工 or 工作人员.
查/找/收集资料 research material · 参考资料 · 个人资料 profile details · 资料库. 数据 is numeric data; 材料 leans physical or documentary.
Literally a female student, but used for young women generally: 班上的女生 · 女生宿舍 · 那个女生. 女孩(儿) is a girl by age; 女士 is the formal 'Ms'.
Straight before the noun, no measure word: 整个晚上/城市/过程. 全 covers 'all of a set' (全班/全部); 整个 is the one whole thing, undivided.
Separable: 开了两个小时的会 · 开完会 · 开个短会. No object follows it — a specific meeting is 会议: 参加会议 · 召开会议 for convening one.
条 is the classifier: 一条短信 · 发/收/回短信. Strictly carrier SMS — nowadays verification codes and spam; chat messages are 消息 (回消息/发微信).
Romantic love as an abstraction: 爱情故事/小说 · 相信爱情 · 爱情观. Dating is 谈恋爱; loving a person is 爱他. 感情 is the feeling inside a relationship.
Causative and separable: 伤了他的心 hurt his feelings. Also 别伤心 · 为这事伤心 · 伤心事 · 伤心得哭了. 难过 is the everyday 'feel bad'; 悲伤 is written grief.
In practice an email inbox or address: 发到我的邮箱 · 邮箱地址 · 查邮箱 · 企业邮箱. The message itself is 邮件; the street postbox sense lives on in 信箱.
First-hand trying-out: 体验生活 · 体验新功能 · 亲身体验 · 用户体验 UX. 经验 is accumulated know-how; 经历 is the events you've been through.
Formal and collective: 青年人 · 有志青年 · 青年节 · 青少年 teens. In conversation you'd say 年轻人. The ladder: 少年 · 青年 · 中年 · 老年.
Counted with 对: 这对夫妻 · 夫妻俩 · 夫妻关系. 夫妇 is the formal version used after a surname (张先生夫妇). Speech uses 老公/老婆; writing 丈夫/妻子.
坐/乘高铁 · 高铁站/票 · 高铁线路. It's the G-train network; 动车 (D trains) are the slower tier, and 火车 is the general word covering both.
Takes a proposal or a clause: 同意这个方案 · 同意你的看法 · 同意他去. 答应 is agreeing to do what someone asked; 赞成 is being in favor of a course.
Separable: 发了三天烧 · 发高烧 · 不发烧了. Bringing it down is 退烧. Unrelated slang: 发烧友 = an obsessive hobbyist (audiophiles, gear geeks).
Two poles. Admiring: 你真厉害. Severe: 疼得厉害 · 病得很厉害 — as a 得-complement it just intensifies the bad thing. 害 is neutral tone, lìhai.
Verb 'be used to': 习惯了这里的生活 · 不习惯 · 习惯早起. Noun: 好/坏习惯 · 养成习惯 form one · 改掉习惯 · 生活习惯.
家 marks an accomplished practitioner: 作家 · 音乐家 · 科学家 · 摄影家. 位 is the respectful classifier: 这位画家. Someone who just paints is 画画的.
Object is the feeling itself: 感到高兴/意外/惊讶 · 感到压力 · 感到饿. For an opinion or judgement, 觉得/认为 are the natural verbs. 感到 is a shade more written than 觉得.
Written stand-in for 吗 / V-not-V: sits before the verb and the sentence takes no 吗 — 是否愿意 · 请确认是否收到. Also embeds a clause: 不知道他是否会来.
A count of discrete things: 数量多/少 · 增加/控制数量 · 数量上. Its standing partner is 质量 quality (保证质量和数量); the volume of an activity is 量 — 工作量, 饭量.
Any notable figure — writer, scientist, athlete — not just entertainers (those are 明星): 社会名人 · 名人效应 · 名人名言 famous sayings.
Looking for faults or verifying: 检查作业/身体 · 检查一遍 · 检查出问题 (result complement). Also a noun: 做个检查 · 安全检查. Looking information up is 查.
Also how children address any woman of their mother's generation (张阿姨), and the ordinary word for a cleaner or nanny — 请个阿姨. Father's sister is 姑姑.
Locative, sits before the verb as 'inwardly': 心里想 · 心里难受 · 心里有数 know where one stands · 记在心里 · 心里话 what one really thinks. 心中 is the literary twin.
The problem goes first as a topic, never as its object: 钱丢了，怎么办？ Embeds too: 不知道该怎么办 · 该怎么办才好. 怎么办 asks for a fix; 怎么了 asks what happened.
Takes an object or a whole clause: 害怕黑 · 害怕失败 · 害怕他不来. Everyday speech often just uses 怕 (我怕冷); 害怕 is heavier. 恐怕 'I'm afraid that…' is a separate adverb.
Takes a clause or another verb: 忘记带钥匙 · 忘记他说过什么. Speech leans on bare 忘 + 了 (我忘了), and the potential form is 忘不了 can't forget · 别忘了.
Also the computing term: 下拉菜单 dropdown · 菜单栏 menu bar · 右键菜单 context menu. Restaurant: 看菜单 · 点菜.
The verb is 办 or 申请: 办签证 · 申请签证 · 签证到期 expires · 延期/续签 renew · 拒签 be refused · 免签 visa-free · 旅游/学生签证.
The western region of a country, not the West as a civilization (西方): 中国西部 · 西部大开发 · 美国西部片 westerns. A direction from where you stand is 西边/以西.
Grasping the reasoning, and also 'be understanding of': 我理解你的心情 · 请多理解 · 表示理解 · 可以理解 understandable · 理解力. Merely following what's said is 懂/明白.
Always relative to someone: 对我们很有利, or written 有利于 + verb phrase — 有利于健康. Attributive 有利条件/地位. Opposite 不利, same patterns.
Counted 一根香蕉; a bunch is 一串/一把香蕉 · 剥香蕉 peel one · 香蕉皮.
Narrative 'thereupon' — the second clause is the next action: 天黑了，于是我们回家了. Often 于是就. For spelling out a reason's result, 所以/因此 fit better.
The general word: 外语水平 · 外语系 · 学一门外语 (measure 门) · 第二外语. 外文 attaches to written material — 外文书/资料/文献; 外国话 is the colloquial one.
Any man of your father's generation is addressed this way — 张叔叔, 谢谢叔叔. Strictly father's younger brother; his elder brother is 伯伯/大伯. 大叔 = middle-aged guy.
Titles follow the surname in address: 王校长 · 校长好. 当/担任校长 serve as. It covers everything from primary-school head to university president.
Read shēngyi, neutral second syllable. 做生意 be in business · 谈生意 · 生意好/不好 · 生意人. 商业 is commerce as a domain, 业务 a firm's line of work.
Forest at scale; a small stand of trees is 树林. 森林公园 · 原始森林 old-growth · 森林火灾 · 森林覆盖率.
Metric km — the traditional 里 is 500 m, so 一公里 = 两里. 走了三公里 · 时速八十公里 · 每公里 · 平方公里.
Written register, introduces a list and often closes with 等/等等 — 例如北京、上海等. Heads the example itself; the spoken counterpart is 比如(说).
Separable: the spouse goes in a 和/跟 phrase — 和他结婚 marry him · 结过婚 · 结了三次婚 · 结婚十年了. Transitive 'marry sb' is 娶 (a wife) / 嫁给 (a husband).
Frame 对…(很)满意 — 我对结果很满意 — and it also takes the thing directly, as in the card's sentence. 不满意 · 令人满意 · 满意的答复 · 满意度.
In questions it means 'on earth' and wants a wh-word or A-not-A, not 吗: 到底是谁？ · 你到底去不去？ In statements, 'in the end' — 到底还是他赢了. Literal: 坚持到底.
The porn reading only surfaces in fixed pairings — 黄色网站/小说/录像, 扫黄 anti-porn drive; on its own it is just the colour, as in the card's 黄色的裙子.
Usually postposed to the set it partitions: 我们当中最高的 · 三个人当中 · 这当中另有原因. For a physical midpoint, 中间 (坐在中间).
Takes a following verb phrase, not a noun: 打算出国 · 打算怎么办 · 没打算去. Also a noun — 你有什么打算？ 计划 is the formal twin and does take noun objects.
The simultaneity use needs both halves: 一边看书一边听音乐; speech clips it to 边看边听. Separately it is 'one side': 一边高一边低 · 站到一边去.
Beyond 'date' it is life as it is lived: 过日子 get by · 日子过得真快 · 好日子 the good times · 挑个好日子 pick an auspicious one. A calendar date on a form is 日期.
Also 'business day' in delivery and processing language: 三到五个工作日内 within 3–5 business days. Its opposites are 休息日 and 节假日.
Negates necessity, not permission: 不用担心 · 不用谢 · 不用了 'no thanks' when declining. 不要 is a prohibition, 不能 an inability — 不用去 just means there's no need.
School-flavoured 'guy': students, and loosely any young man — 班里的男生 · 那个男生. Adults at work are 男的/男士, a child is 男孩. Pair: 女生.
Verb-object already, so it takes no object of its own: 在家办公 work from home · 办公时间/地点 · 办公用品 supplies · 办公室. General 'work' is 工作/办事.
Of places, and of people holding their noise: 请安静 · 安静一点 · 安静下来 settle down · 安安静静地看书. Of a person's nature it means placid.
Object is whatever gets pulled in: 吸引注意/眼球 · 吸引游客/投资/人才 · 被他的声音吸引 · 很有吸引力 appealing. The magnet sense sits behind all of it.
What is emitted or issued follows: 发出声音/光/气味 · 发出邀请/命令/警告/信号. Sending a message or file is 发送/发过去; 发出 is something leaving its source.
Doubles as a verb 'be X away from', as in the card's sentence: 这里距离市中心十公里 · 距离考试还有三天. Noun: 保持距离 · 有一段距离 quite a way · 距离感.
Formal 'read a text': 阅读理解 reading comprehension · 课外阅读 · 阅读量/习惯 · 阅读障碍 dyslexia. Everyday speech says 看书/看报; 读书 is studying or reading aloud.
走楼梯 take the stairs · 上/下楼梯 · 爬楼梯 climb · 楼梯口 · 楼梯间 stairwell. A single step, or an outdoor flight, is 台阶; the lift is 电梯.
Adverb of the immediate past, right before the verb: 他刚刚出门 · 刚刚才知道. Second sense 'exactly': 刚刚好 just right · 刚刚够. 刚才 is a time word (刚才的事).
Strictly the address string; the site itself is 网站: 网址是什么？ · 把网址发给我 · 复制网址 copy the link. You 访问/上 a 网站, not a 网址.
Separable and intransitive: 大学毕业 (card's line) · 从北大毕业 · 毕业于清华 (formal) · 毕了业再说 · 毕业生/毕业典礼. The school goes before it, or after 从/于.
Needs a 和/与/跟 phrase in front: 和去年相比 · 与他相比. Then 相比之下 by comparison · 相比而言. Plain measuring uses 比 (今年比去年好); 相比 sets up the frame.
Object is the question or the person: 回答问题 · 回答我 · 回答不上来 can't come up with an answer. Also a noun: 他的回答. Replying to a message is 回复; 答应 = agree.
Beyond ugly: 脸色很难看 looking grim or unwell · 输得很难看 lose badly · 闹得太难看 an ugly scene. Parallel to 难听 harsh to hear and 难闻 bad-smelling.
Adverb before the verb: 常常去/常常忘. Negate with 不常 or 很少 rather than 不常常. 经常 is the close twin, a shade more formal and also a modifier (经常性).
Pairs with 多/少 rather than 大/小: 人数很多 · 人数不够 · 统计/清点人数 · 人数超过五百. Same family: 字数 word count, 次数 number of times, 人次 person-visits.
Nearly always about elapsed time, with a negative or a duration: 好久没见 · 好久不见 · 等了好久 · 好久以前. 好 here is 'quite a', as in 好几个/好多.
Grassy ground in general; a manicured lawn is 草坪 (请勿践踏草坪) and open steppe is 草原. Locative takes 上: 在草地上玩.
Follows its landmark: 学校附近 · 这附近 around here · 附近有超市吗？ It is a place word, so it can be the subject or take 在/到 — 就在附近.
开/关空调 turn it on/off · 装空调 install · 空调坏了 · 空调房 an air-conditioned room · 中央空调. The cool air itself is 冷气, the southern and Taiwan word.
Modifier for the details: 具体情况/时间/要求/内容. As a discourse move, 具体来说 to be specific · 具体到每个人. 具体点儿 asks someone to get concrete; opposite 抽象.
In China the whole southern half as a cultural region — 南方人 · 南方话 · 南方菜. The southern portion of a named place is 南部; a direction from you is 南边.
十字路口 crossroads · 丁字路口 T-junction · 到路口左转 · 在路口等我. Chinese directions hang on 路口 the way English uses 'the corner'.
Separable — a length splits it: 放三天假 · 放暑假 · 学校下周放假. Institutions 放假; an individual asking for leave 请假, and the time off itself is 假期.
Financial register — object is the money or charge: 支付费用/租金/工资 · 移动支付 · 支付方式 · 支付宝. Daily speech says 付钱/付款/给钱.
Postposed and personal: 在大家面前 · 摆在我面前 · 困难面前不低头. 前面 is the plain spatial 'ahead' (前面有个路口) with no sense of facing anyone.
The long coat specifically: 一件大衣 · 穿上/脱下大衣 · 羽绒大衣. Any outer layer at all is 外套; a down jacket 羽绒服, a trench coat 风衣.
Verb-object, so it splits: 开了花 · 树上开满了花 · 花开了. Figurative: 心里乐开了花 delighted · 遍地开花 spring up everywhere.
A time word, not an adverb — it can head the sentence or modify a noun: 刚才我在开会 · 刚才的电话 · 刚才那个人. Bare 刚/刚刚 goes before the verb instead (他刚走).
行 is háng here, the 'trade/firm' reading — same as 同行 peers, 内行 an expert. 去银行 · 在银行工作 · 银行卡/账户 · 银行转账.
Neutral-tone sūnzi = grandson; the strategist in 《孙子兵法》 is Sūnzǐ, full third tone — the card's sentence. Daughter's son is 外孙, granddaughter 孙女.
送他一份礼物 / 送礼物给他 · 收到礼物 · 一份 or 一件礼物 · 生日礼物 · 礼物清单. Gift-giving as social custom is 送礼, which hints at currying favour.
Lives in a 对 frame with 有 or 感: 对音乐很有兴趣 / 很感兴趣 · 引起兴趣 · 培养兴趣 · 兴趣爱好 hobbies · 兴趣班 after-school class.
Sharing something good with people: 分享经验/心得/快乐 · 跟大家分享一下 · 分享到朋友圈. Splitting a thing up is 分; sharing a burden is 分担.
Three loads: 建筑材料 physical stock · a dish's ingredients · and paperwork — 申请材料 application documents, 参考材料. 他是块当老师的材料 = the makings of.
The cause behind a fact: 主要原因 · 找出原因 · 原因在于… · 出于…原因. 理由 is the justification you offer (没有理由拒绝); 原因 explains, 理由 defends.
Written 能不能: 请问能否明天答复 · 不确定他能否按时到. The verb follows it directly and the sentence takes no 吗. Speech uses 能不能/可不可以.
Usually a modifier, not a predicate: 快速发展/增长 · 快速通道 fast lane · 快速充电 · 快速反应. Of a thing's actual speed you say 很快. Written and technical.
An indoor sports hall or arena for PE and events — a workout gym is 健身房. 去体育馆打球 · 体育馆开放时间. The open-air stadium is 体育场.
Also 'find it odd', with a clause: 我很奇怪他为什么没来 · 觉得很奇怪. Discourse frame 奇怪的是… oddly enough. Bare 怪 is the adverb 'rather': 怪好看的.
Of a person's quickness: 又聪明又用功 · 聪明的做法 a smart move · 装聪明 act clever. A wise decision is 明智; 聪明反被聪明误 = outsmarting yourself.
Separable — the target goes inside: 生他的气 be angry at him · 别跟我生气 · 生了半天气. 气 alone is the transitive one: 你气死我了 you infuriate me.
Two jobs: the hedge 'seems' — 好像要下雨了 (card's line) · 我好像见过他; and the simile 好像…一样/似的 — 高兴得好像个孩子一样. As a hedge it softens claims.
A formulation or claim, something you weigh for truth: 这种说法不准确 · 换个说法 put it another way · 有一种说法是… there's a saying. 讨个说法 demand an accounting.
The stretch of time itself: 暑假/寒假 · 假期作业 · 假期期间 · 度过假期. Getting it is 放假 (institution) or 请假 (you asking); a public holiday date is 假日.
Indexes single characters; a word-and-phrase dictionary is 词典, also in this deck. 查字典 look it up · 一本字典 · 《新华字典》 is the standard one.
An organised sub-unit, not just a cluster of people: 分成四个小组 · 小组讨论/作业 · 学习小组 · 小组赛 group stage. Its head is 组长.
Separable: 去日本留学 · 出国留学 · 留过两年学 · 留学生/留学申请. The destination normally comes ahead of it with 去/在 — 在英国留学.
People and problems alike: 遇到老朋友 · 遇到困难/麻烦/问题 · 遇到这种情况. 碰到/碰见 is the chattier twin for running into someone; 遇见 is warmer, more literary.
The course as a programme; a single session is 课 (今天有三节课). 选课 pick courses · 课程安排/设置 · 必修/选修课程 · 在线课程 · 课程表 timetable.
Roughly 10–17 and mostly written: 少年时代 boyhood · 青少年 adolescents · 少年犯 juvenile offender · 少年宫. Read shào here, the 'young' reading, not shǎo.
Register scale: 旅馆 budget inn · 宾馆 plain mid-range, slightly dated, state-run in flavour · 酒店 the modern default · 民宿 B&B. 住宾馆 stay at one.
The verb is 刷: 刷信用卡 · 盗刷 a fraudulent charge, as in the card's sentence · 办/申请信用卡 · 还信用卡 pay it off · 信用卡账单. Debit card is 借记卡.
Mostly the staged event: 一场演出 · 演出开始/结束 · 参加/举行演出 · 巡回演出 tour · 演出服. The performing itself is 表演, which takes an object: 表演节目/魔术.
Also asks about availability: 你明天方便吗？ · 方便的话 if it's no trouble · 提供方便. 方便面 instant noodles; 去方便一下 is the euphemism for a toilet trip.
Counted 一本护照 · 办/申请护照 · 出示护照 present it (card's line) · 护照过期 expires · 补办/换发 replace or renew · 护照号码.
记笔记 / 做笔记 take notes — the gloss's 'to take note' is really this collocation. 一份笔记 · 课堂笔记 · 笔记本 means both a notebook and a laptop (笔记本电脑).
A collective, not a way to address one person: 姐妹俩 the two of them · 三姐妹 · 兄弟姐妹 siblings · 好姐妹 close girlfriends · 姐妹城市 sister cities.
Heavier than English 'criticize' — a reprimand, usually downward: 老师批评了他 · 受到/挨批评 get told off · 提出批评. Appraising a work is 评论/评价.
Of people it is warm and hospitable, not romantic passion: 对客人很热情 · 热情招待/欢迎. As a noun, enthusiasm — 工作热情 · 充满热情 · 热情不高.
Object is something scheduled or granted: 取消比赛/航班/会议/预约 · 取消订单 · 取消资格 disqualify. Deleting data is 删除; undoing a decision is 撤销.
Making something new, against 发现 for finding what was already there: 发明电灯 vs 发现新星. Also a noun — 一项发明 · 发明专利 · 发明家.
Idiomatically 'ages', with a note of exasperation: 找了半天 (card's line) · 等了你半天 · 说了半天你还不懂. The literal half-day survives in 上/下半天.
Separable: 拍张照 · 拍了几张照 · 给我拍个照. To photograph a subject, 拍 takes it directly — 拍风景 · 拍我. 照相 is the older-sounding twin.
Commercial food products: 进口食品 · 食品安全/包装/添加剂 · 冷冻食品. What you actually eat is 食物, a cooked dish is 菜. 食品 belongs on labels and in shops.
Separable: 照张相 · 照了几张相 · 给他照相. Sounds a shade dated next to 拍照; 照相机 camera and 照相馆 photo studio keep it current.
Sits in the 可+verb family 'worth V-ing': 可爱 lovable, 可怕 frightening, 可笑 laughable, 可惜 a pity. 长得很可爱 · 可爱的小狗 · 卖萌 is the slangy act of playing cute.
Separable: 开个玩笑 · 别开玩笑了 · 开他的玩笑 / 拿他开玩笑 tease him · 你开玩笑吧？ you're kidding. 玩笑 rarely appears without 开.
Two objects: 提醒我开会 remind me to · 提醒他注意安全 · 提醒一下 · 我提醒过你 I did warn you. It is the neutral 'flag it'; a formal warning is 警告.
For abstractions: 印象深刻 make a strong impression · 深刻的教训/理解/变化 · 深刻反思. Physical depth is plain 深 (水很深).
Adverbial before the verb: 认真学习 · 认真听/认真考虑. Predicate: 他工作很认真 conscientious · 我是认真的 I mean it. Taking a joke literally is 当真.
Works bare before the verb — 他突然摔倒了, no 地 needed — and as a predicate: 太突然了 · 来得很突然 · 突然袭击. 忽然 is the interchangeable adverb-only twin.
Doubles as a noun you handle: 遇到/克服困难 · 有困难找我 · 生活困难 hard up · 困难重重. As an adjective it is weightier and more formal than plain 难.
Anchors to a reference point: 不久以后/之后 soon after · 不久前 not long ago · 出门后不久 (card's line) · 过了不久. Sentence-initially: 不久他就回来了.
Object is a principle or a knack, often a verb phrase: 懂得珍惜 · 懂得感恩 · 懂得怎么做. Understanding words or a language is plain 懂 — 听不懂 · 懂中文.
You 戴 a hat, not 穿: 戴帽子 · 摘/脱帽子 take it off · 一顶帽子. Figurative 扣帽子 pin a label on someone · 绿帽子 cuckold.
Counted 一条裙子 · 穿裙子 · 短裙 miniskirt · 半身裙 when the contrast matters. Careful: 连衣裙 is a dress, not a skirt.
Separable: 洗个澡 · 洗了半个小时澡 · 天天洗澡. It covers bath and shower both; specify with 淋浴 shower or 泡澡 soak. 洗澡水 · 洗澡间.
Fixed frame 对…感兴趣: 她对摄影很感兴趣 · 不感兴趣. The degree word goes inside — 很/非常感兴趣. The noun version is 对…有兴趣.
Indexes words and phrases; single characters are 字典's job. 查词典 · 一本词典 · 汉英/双语词典 · 电子词典. 辞典 is the older, Taiwan-flavoured spelling.
Takes a verb phrase directly: 继续说 · 继续努力 · 继续下去 keep it up. Noun objects are limited to set terms like 继续教育. 接着 moves to the next action; 继续 resumes.
Separable: 搬过三次家 · 帮我搬家 · 下个月搬家. The destination goes with plain 搬 — 搬到北京 · 搬走 · 搬出去 move out. Moving an object is also 搬 (搬桌子).
As an adverb it is an urgent plea, nearly always imperative and usually negative: 千万不要 · 千万别忘了 · 千万记住 · 千万小心. Literal 'ten million': 千万富翁.
一块蛋糕 a slice vs 一个蛋糕 the whole thing · 切蛋糕 · 生日蛋糕 · 奶油蛋糕. Figurative 分蛋糕 / 做大蛋糕 = dividing or growing the economic pie.
Sets up a reversal: 本来想去，后来没去. With 就 it flips to 'was that way all along' — 他本来就不同意. 原来 is 'as it turns out'; 本来 is 'as it was'.
Person first, then what about: 通知他去开会 · 通知大家明天放假 · 提前通知. Also the notice itself — 发/接到通知 · 一份通知 · 录取通知书 admission letter.
Everyday 'grown-up', paired against 小孩: 大人说话小孩别插嘴 · 一个大人两个小孩. The legal term is 成年人. The 'my lord' sense (包大人) is costume-drama only.
上名单 / 列入名单 be on the list · 名单上没有他 · 公布名单 announce · 黑名单 blacklist · 获奖/参赛名单. It is names specifically; a shopping list is 清单/单子.
Takes a whole clause and usually opens with no subject: 听说他要走了. 听说过 = have heard of (没听说过这个人). It flags hearsay, softening what you can't vouch for.
Hedges quantities and states: 差不多十点 about ten · 差不多好了 nearly done · 跟他差不多高. 差不多了 also closes things off ('that'll do').
Resultative — negate with 没, not 不: 没收到你的邮件. Potential forms: 信号收不到 can't get a signal · 收得到. 收 alone is the act — 收礼物 · 收快递.
Transitive: 适合老年人 (card's line) · 适合初学者 · 这本书适合我. Its mirror 合适 is the predicate with no object — 这件衣服很合适 · 找个合适的时间.
With 了 it means vanished: 钥匙不见了 · 人不见了. Bare 不见 is refusing a meeting — 他谁都不见. Set phrases: 好久不见 · 不见不散 be there or be square.
Northern China as a cultural half — 北方人 · 北方话 · 北方菜, roughly north of the Huai River. The northern part of a named place is 北部; a direction from you, 北边.
The spoken counterpart of 例如: 比如说吧 · 比如这个 · 比如水果，苹果香蕉都行. It can head a fragment mid-conversation; 例如 belongs to writing and lists closing in 等.
Object is the reaction it triggers: 引起注意/重视 · 引起误会/争议/不满 · 引起火灾. 造成 is for damage done (造成损失), 导致 for a bad outcome.
Also 'in short supply / strained': 时间紧张 · 资金紧张 · 关系紧张 tense relations · 局势紧张. Of people: 别紧张 relax · 紧张得说不出话.
Written-register 好像: 他似乎不太高兴 · 似乎有些道理 · 事情似乎并不简单. Adverb only, so it can't run the 好像…一样 comparison. Speech prefers 好像/看起来.
Everyday word for a patient; hospital signage and medical writing say 患者 (糖尿病患者). 照顾病人 · 病人家属 the family · 重症病人.
Preposition plus a noun, then the main clause: 按照计划进行 · 按照规定办 · 按照他的说法. 根据 is close but leans evidential (根据调查); 按 is the clipped spoken form.
'Then / go on': 你接着说 carry on · 先吃饭，接着看电影 · 紧接着 right after. Also literal — 接着! catch it. 继续 resumes the same activity; 接着 starts the next.
In practice 'email', short for 电子邮件: 发/收一封邮件 · 邮件地址 · 查收邮件. A parcel is 包裹, courier delivery 快递; 邮件 as physical post is postal-service language.
Negative by default: 严重的后果 · 承担后果 bear the consequences · 后果自负 you're liable · 后果不堪设想 unthinkable. Neutral outcomes are 结果.
Everyday 'quality': 质量好/差 · 提高/保证质量 · 质量问题 a defect · 产品质量 · 生活质量. Physics 'mass' is the same word; Taiwan says 品质 for the quality sense.
Fronts the clause as an inference from evidence: 看来今天要下雨了 · 看来他是不来了. With a person it becomes a viewpoint frame: 在我看来 in my view · 在他看来.
Verb-object: 手机关机了 · 关了机 · 关机重启. Its pair is 开机 boot up. Closing an app is 关掉/退出; hanging up a call is 挂电话.
Needs an open-ended slot — a wh-word, A-not-A, or 多么 — and 都/也 in the second clause: 不管谁来都一样 · 不管多难也要做. Spoken; 无论/不论 are the written twins.
Covers taste and smell both: 味道很香/很怪 · 什么味道？ On its own, 有味道 often hints at a bad smell; figuratively it is 'has character' (这幅画很有味道). Colloquial 味儿.
Correlative with 而且/还/也: 他不但聪明还很勤奋. Same subject, 不但 follows it; different subjects, 不但 goes first — 不但我去，他也去. 不仅 is the written twin.
A refusal or verdict: 这样不行 · 我不行了 I'm done for. Also a degree complement where it just means 'extremely': 累得不行 dead tired · 疼得不行.
The occasion itself: 传统节日 · 过节 celebrate one · 节日气氛 festive mood · 节日快乐. A day off work is 假日/假期; 节日 is about what's being marked.
Written 不管: 不论天气怎样 · 不论男女老少 · 不论如何. Same requirement — an open slot, then 都/也 in the second clause. 无论 is interchangeable and commonest.
Weightier than 谢谢, for speeches and writing: 感谢大家的支持 · 表示感谢 · 感谢信 · 非常感谢. Takes a person plus what for; everyday thanks is 谢谢.
Transitive — you 开发 something: 开发新产品/软件/市场 · 开发资源 · 开发商 property developer · 开发区. 发展 is growth without an object (经济发展).
An identifying string, not a quantity: 电话号码 · 身份证号码 · 房间号码 · 拨号码 dial. Speech shortens it to 号 (我的手机号). Counting numbers are 数字.
Verb-object like 放假: 三点放学 · 放学以后 · 还没放学. Going to school is 上学; 下课 ends a single period, 放学 ends the school day.
Sad, but also physically wretched: 心里很难过 · 胃里难过 queasy · 为他难过 feel bad for him · 别难过. 伤心 is sharper grief; 难受 is the same discomfort minus the sorrow.
保持冷静 keep calm · 冷静下来 cool off · 你冷静点 · 冷静地分析. It is level-headed judgement, not coldness toward people — that is 冷淡/冷漠.
Pairs with 大/小: 压力很大 · 工作/学习压力 · 承受压力 bear it · 减轻/缓解压力 relieve · 给他很大压力 · 有压力才有动力.
Usually with 就: 马上就来 · 马上就要开始了 for an imminent event. 立刻/立即 are the crisper, more formal versions; 马上 stretches to 'in a bit' in practice.
Mass-ish noun: 一件行李 a piece · 收拾行李 pack · 托运/取行李 check in and collect · 手提行李 carry-on · 行李箱 suitcase. Read xíngli, neutral second syllable.
Adverb summing a total, before the verb: 一共多少钱？ · 一共有五个人 · 一共花了两小时. 总共 is the same with a formal tinge; 一起 means jointly, not a total.
Formal 'talks' as much as chat: 与对方对话 · 展开/进行对话 · 中美对话. A film's spoken lines are 对白; a software dialog box is 对话框.
老年人 is the neutral demographic term (老年人优惠); 老人 is everyday, and 老人家 the respectful way to address one. 照顾老人 · 空巢老人 empty-nesters.
Mostly institutional: 对外开放 · 开放时间 opening hours · 向学生开放 · 改革开放. Of a person, 思想开放 open-minded. The flower sense in the card's line is literary.
Food, air and novelty alike: 新鲜的水果 · 新鲜空气 · 新鲜事 something new · 新鲜感 the novelty · 图个新鲜 do it for the novelty · 没什么新鲜的.
Object is time, people or an event: 安排时间/工作/住宿 · 安排他去 assign him · 安排好了 all set. Also a noun — 你有什么安排？ · 课程安排 the schedule.
Object is normally the person: 原谅他 · 请你原谅我 · 请多原谅, the set formula in letters. 不可原谅 unforgivable. Asking for it is 请求原谅; apologising is 道歉.
Formal 'correct' for answers, views and decisions: 正确答案 · 正确的做法 · 正确对待. Speech just says 对 (你说得对). 准确 = accurate, a different axis.
Two directions: 我怀疑他在撒谎 suspect that he is, and 怀疑自己的能力 doubt it. Takes a noun or a clause · 值得怀疑 questionable · 毫无疑问 beyond doubt.
Almost always a modifier: 常用词 · 常用汉字 · 常用工具/方法 · 最常用的. As a predicate you would say 很常用 or 经常用.
Determiner or standalone: 别的颜色 · 还有别的吗？ · 我不想要别的. Note that 'other people' has its own word, 别人, far commoner than 别的人.
Member by subscription or enrolment: 办会员 sign up · 会员卡/价 · 付费会员 · 会员制. A member of a team or family is 成员 (家庭成员); of a party, 党员.
Object is a burden or an intensity: 减轻压力/负担/痛苦/症状 · 减轻处罚 lighten a penalty. 减少 cuts a count (减少人数); 减轻 makes what remains easier to bear.
Urging tone, mostly in commands and plans: 赶快走吧 · 你赶快去看看 · 赶快把事办完. 赶紧 is the more colloquial twin; 马上 states timing without the push.
Separable, and normally reduplicated in narrative: 点了点头 · 点点头 · 点了一下头. 点头同意/答应 nod one's assent. Its opposite is 摇头.
Lives in set well-wishes and descriptions: 合作愉快 · 旅途/周末愉快 · 心情愉快 · 玩得很愉快. For 'I'm happy' right now, 高兴/开心; 愉快 rates the experience.
Commercial register: 购物中心 mall · 购物车 shopping cart, also the website kind · 网上购物 · 购物节. Everyday speech says 买东西 or 逛街.
Recognising by sight, and a touch colloquial: 我认得他 · 认得路 know the way · 不认得这个字. 认识 is the neutral default and covers being acquainted.
讲/说个笑话 tell one. Also a verb meaning mock: 别笑话我 don't laugh at me · 让人笑话 be laughed at. 闹笑话 make a fool of yourself · 成了个笑话 a laughing stock.
Three roles at once: host to a 客人, owner of a pet or property, and master. 男/女主人 the man or woman of the house · 主人公 the protagonist of a story.
Leaving something behind or keeping it: 留下一张纸条 · 留下地址/电话 · 给他留下好印象. 留下来 = stay on. What is left over by itself is 剩下 (剩下三个).
As a bare noun it is the motorway — 走高速, the card's line, short for 高速公路. As a modifier: 高速发展 · 高速运转 · 高速摄影. 高铁 is the train (高速铁路).
Counted 一份报纸 · 看报纸, clipped to 看报 in speech · 订报纸 subscribe · 登在报纸上 appear in the paper. 报社 is the newspaper as an organisation.
